title: rotate_channel must not lose messages appended mid-rotation
desc: DEFECT (cormac review #a047281b finding 2, deterministic repro tests/repro_t-56ac_rotate_loss.py in PR #4): bin/chatcode:1166-1181 — snapshot :1168, old/keep :1174, archive write :1177, sha re-read :1178, final write :1179-1180 of ONLY keep with the FRESH sha; a message arriving between :1168 and :1178 lands in neither hot file nor archive. Sibling: arrival between :1178-:1180 = uncaught Conflict after the say already printed success. NOTE: write_text_retry alone does NOT fix this — the final write must re-verify no new lines arrived since the snapshot (or write keep+new). ACCEPTANCE: (1) extend/point at the committed repro: injection test proves zero loss and no crash; (2) red on main, green on branch; (3) no format changes (R10).
